Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium package?
The Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium is a holistic wellness checkup that links physical health with mental wellbeing in a single 80+ parameter assessment. Unlike a standard full body checkup that looks only at organ function, this package also screens stress-related hormones, mood-influencing nutrients (Vitamin B12, Vitamin D, iron, folate), thyroid markers and inflammation indicators that directly affect energy, focus, mood and sleep. It is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. How is the Mind & Body Premium different from a regular full body checkup?
A regular full body checkup screens vital organs — heart, liver, kidney, thyroid and blood sugar. The Mind & Body Premium adds an entirely separate layer focused on the biological factors that influence mental wellbeing, including stress-response markers, mood-affecting nutrient deficiencies and inflammation markers linked to fatigue and low mood. This dual scope is why Indian professionals, founders and high-stress workers increasingly choose this package — it answers both "are my organs healthy" and "why am I feeling this way" in a single report.
3. Which stress and mood-related parameters are included in this package?
The Mind & Body Premium typically screens stress-influenced hormones (such as thyroid and cortisol-axis indicators), mood-linked nutrient levels (Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, folate, iron, ferritin), inflammation markers (HsCRP), homocysteine for cognitive risk, and full thyroid profile — all of which are biologically tied to energy, focus, sleep and emotional regulation. Alongside this, the standard organ panels for heart, liver, kidney, diabetes and CBC are included. The exact 80+ parameter list is published on the package page on bookmytest.co.in.
4. Can this package help identify biological causes of brain fog, low mood or chronic fatigue?
Yes, this is one of the strongest use cases for the Mind & Body Premium. Persistent brain fog, low mood, poor concentration and unexplained fatigue often have underlying biological drivers — low Vitamin B12, low Vitamin D, low ferritin, subclinical hypothyroidism, elevated inflammation or disturbed stress hormones. These conditions are very common in Indian adults yet routinely missed because no single basic test captures them all. Detecting and correcting these biological factors often produces noticeable improvement in mental clarity and energy within weeks.
5. Is the Mind & Body Premium useful for burnout or workplace mental fatigue?
Yes. Burnout is not purely psychological — chronic work stress alters cortisol patterns, depletes B-vitamins, lowers Vitamin D from indoor work, raises systemic inflammation and can disturb thyroid function. The Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium screens for these biological markers of stress burden, which is why it is increasingly used by Indian corporate professionals, founders, IT employees, doctors and consultants who recognise the early signs of burnout. The report gives a measurable baseline that can be improved through targeted nutrition, sleep, recovery and medical guidance.
6. Does this package screen sleep-related biological markers?
Indirectly, yes. Sleep quality is closely tied to thyroid function, Vitamin D status, magnesium levels, iron stores, blood sugar regulation and inflammation — all of which are evaluated through the Mind & Body Premium panel. Persistent poor sleep despite good sleep hygiene often reflects one or more of these biological imbalances rather than a behavioural problem. While the package does not include a sleep study, it is a strong first step to identify whether nutritional, hormonal or metabolic factors are contributing to disturbed sleep before considering specialist evaluation.
7. Who should consider booking the Mind & Body Premium package?
This package is ideal for Indian adults aged 25 to 55 in high-cognitive-load or high-stress roles — IT professionals, doctors, founders, consultants, finance and creative professionals, students preparing for competitive exams, caregivers, and parents balancing work with childcare. It is also valuable for anyone experiencing persistent fatigue, poor concentration, low mood, sleep disturbance or unexplained weight changes despite a normal lifestyle. Adults already in therapy or considering psychiatric consultation also benefit, as biological baseline data complements clinical mental health care.
8. How is mental wellbeing biologically connected to physical health?
Mental and physical health share the same biological foundation — hormones, neurotransmitter precursors, nutrients and inflammation. Low Vitamin D is consistently linked to depressive symptoms; Vitamin B12 deficiency affects memory and mood; subclinical thyroid disorder mimics depression; chronic inflammation is associated with low mood and brain fog; and disturbed cortisol patterns affect both sleep and immunity. By screening these markers together, the Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium provides a measurable, evidence-based view of the body systems that shape mental wellbeing.
9. Will this package replace seeing a psychologist or psychiatrist?
No, and this is important to be clear about. The Mind & Body Premium does not diagnose or treat psychiatric conditions like depression, anxiety disorders or bipolar disorder, and it is not a substitute for mental health professionals. What it does is identify biological factors that can either cause or worsen mental wellbeing symptoms. The ideal approach is to use the report as complementary input — share it with both your general physician and your mental health professional so that biological, psychological and lifestyle dimensions are addressed together.
10. How should I interpret and act on my Mind & Body Premium report?
The report uses Metropoliss colour-coded format — green for normal, yellow for borderline, red for out-of-range. A complimentary doctor consultation is typically included with bookings on bookmytest.co.in, which is particularly valuable for this package because interpreting stress, nutritional and hormonal markers together requires clinical context. Most flagged values are reversible through targeted supplementation, structured sleep, dietary changes, sunlight exposure and stress management. Repeat testing after 3 to 6 months helps measure whether interventions are working.

This package offers a comprehensive assessment of heart health by checking cholesterol levels, inflammation markers, and artery health indicators. It helps detect early risks and supports timely medical intervention.
Can this test help prevent future heart issues?
Yes, early detection of abnormal lipid levels, inflammation, and plaque risk markers can help individuals make lifestyle changes or seek medical advice, reducing the chances of future heart complications.

1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus package?
Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus is a wide-spectrum unisex health checkup curated for Indian adults aged 35 to 55 who carry more than one lifestyle risk factor — such as a desk job combined with irregular sleep, occasional drinking and a family history of metabolic disease. It evaluates 70+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering all major organ systems including pancreas and electrolyte balance, which most mid-tier packages skip. It is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. Who specifically should choose Comprehensive Plus over other Metropolis packages?
Comprehensive Plus is the right choice for Indian adults who feel that a basic vital-organ checkup isnt deep enough, but a gender-specific premium package isnt necessary either. It is particularly suited for people aged 35 to 55 with multiple co-existing risk factors, those managing borderline values from previous reports, individuals on long-term medication, post-illness recovery cases, and anyone wanting a single annual baseline that genuinely replaces four to five separate tests. Senior citizens and people with very specific concerns may need an even deeper specialised package.
3. What is the difference between Vital Plus and Comprehensive Plus?
The Vital Plus package focuses on essential vital-organ screening with around 60 parameters and is built for first-time testers aged 25 to 45. Comprehensive Plus expands the scope to 90+ parameters, adding pancreatic function, electrolyte panel, expanded iron studies, additional vitamins and minerals, deeper cardiac risk markers and inflammation markers like HsCRP. It is designed for adults in the 35 to 55 window when subtle metabolic shifts begin and require closer tracking. As a rule of thumb, Vital Plus is your entry baseline; Comprehensive Plus is your mid-life annual standard.
4. Does Comprehensive Plus include cardiac risk assessment beyond basic cholesterol?
Yes. Beyond the standard Lipid Profile, Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus typically adds high-sensitivity CRP (HsCRP), which measures low-grade systemic inflammation linked to heart disease, and expanded lipid breakdown including non-HDL and triglyceride-to-HDL ratio. For Indian adults — who tend to develop coronary artery disease a decade earlier than Western populations — this layered cardiac assessment catches risk that a basic cholesterol number alone misses. Anyone with a family history of heart disease, hypertension or diabetes benefits from this deeper cardiac view.
5. Is Comprehensive Plus a good choice after recovering from a major illness or COVID-19?
Yes, and it is one of the most common reasons Indian adults book this specific package. Post-illness recovery — including post-COVID, post-hospitalisation, post-surgery or recovery from prolonged fever — can leave behind subtle changes in liver enzymes, kidney function, electrolytes, iron stores, blood counts and inflammatory markers. The 70+ parameter scope of Comprehensive Plus covers all of these in one sample, helping you confirm whether your body has returned to baseline. Most physicians recommend post-recovery testing around the 6 to 12 week mark.
6. Can Comprehensive Plus be used as a pre-surgery or pre-medication baseline?
Yes, the package is well suited as a personal baseline before starting any long-term medication, hormone therapy, weight-loss intervention or planned non-emergency surgery. The breadth of parameters — covering liver, kidney, electrolytes, complete blood count, glucose, thyroid and inflammation — gives a strong reference point that your treating doctor can compare against follow-up reports. This makes it easier to detect any medication-induced changes early and adjust therapy. The report should always be shared with your treating physician rather than self-interpreted in such cases.
7. Can I gift the Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus package to my parents through bookmytest.co.in?
Yes, gifting preventive health checkups to parents and in-laws is one of the fastest-growing booking categories on bookmytest.co.in, particularly during festive seasons, birthdays and parents day. You can book the Comprehensive Plus package using your parents name, mobile number and home address, schedule the Metropolis phlebotomist visit at their convenience, and the digital report is delivered directly to their registered mobile so they retain full privacy. The complimentary doctor consultation is also extended to them — making it a thoughtful and clinically meaningful gift.
8. How often should adults aged 35 to 55 take a comprehensive health checkup?
Annually, as a non-negotiable health habit. The 35 to 55 window is when most lifestyle conditions in Indian adults move from invisible to clinical — borderline thyroid becomes overt hypothyroidism, fatty liver progresses to NASH, pre-diabetes converts to Type 2 diabetes, and LDL slowly damages arteries. Annual testing through Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus builds a year-on-year trend line that catches these conversions early. Adults already managing one chronic condition or with a strong family history should consider testing every six months instead of annually.
9. How does Comprehensive Plus compare to a typical corporate health checkup?
Corporate health checkups
offered by Indian employers usually cover 40 to 60 parameters and are designed to meet a baseline standard across a large workforce — they are not tailored to your personal risk profile. The
Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus
offers 70+ parameters with significantly deeper coverage of cardiac risk, electrolytes, iron and inflammation, plus a complimentary doctor consultation for personalised interpretation. For adults who want a genuinely individualised annual assessment rather than a generic workplace check, Comprehensive Plus is the stronger and more clinically useful option.

1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female is an advanced preventive health checkup designed for Indian women aged 30 and above, especially those with a family history of illness or a higher lifestyle risk profile. It evaluates 80+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, anaemia, bone health, hormonal balance, key vitamins and cancer-screening markers. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable online with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. What tests are included in Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female?
The TruHealth ProActive Female package by Metropolis includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), HbA1c and Fasting Blood Sugar, Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Calcium, HsCRP for cardiac inflammation, hormonal markers and a complete Urine Routine examination. The exact 80+ parameter list, normal ranges and sample Metropolis report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking.
3. How is ProActive Female different from the regular Active Female package?
The ProActive Female package is the upgraded, more comprehensive version of the Active Female checkup. While the Active Female covers around 70 parameters focused on core metabolic and nutritional health, the ProActive Female adds extra cancer-screening markers, expanded hormonal panels, deeper cardiac risk assessment and additional bone-health indicators — taking the total to 80+ parameters. It is recommended for women above 30, women with a family history of cancer, diabetes or thyroid disease, and those wanting a deeper annual screening.
4. Why is this Metropolis package recommended for Indian women?
Indian women face a unique combination of high hypothyroidism prevalence, widespread iron-deficiency anaemia, very high Vitamin D deficiency, early-onset metabolic syndrome and rising rates of breast and cervical cancer. The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is curated by Metropolis pathologists to screen exactly these high-prevalence conditions in a single sample. It is particularly valuable for women with a family history of cancer, diabetes, thyroid disorder or heart disease, and for women approaching perimenopause.
5. Is fasting required for the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose and insulin readings, which are directly affected by recent food intake. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your prescription medication unless your doctor specifies otherwise. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours and heavy exercise for 12 hours before the Metropolis phlebotomist arrives, as both can temporarily alter liver enzymes and other key readings.
6. Can I take the Metropolis ProActive Female test during my period?
You can, but a few parameters may be affected. Haemoglobin and ferritin readings can be marginally lower during menstruation, and inflammatory markers like HsCRP may be slightly elevated. For the most accurate results, schedule the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test for the week after your period ends. If your cycle is irregular or your booking is time-sensitive, proceeding is still fine — just inform the phlebotomist so the report can be interpreted accurately by your physician.
7. At what age should Indian women take the ProActive Female checkup?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is ideal for Indian women from age 30 onwards, especially with a family history of illness, sedentary work, irregular cycles, BMI above 25 or post-pregnancy. From age 40, with menopause approaching, the expanded hormonal and bone-health panels become particularly valuable. Annual repeat testing helps build a personal baseline so subtle drift in TSH, ferritin, HbA1c or Vitamin D is caught early and treated before it progresses to clinical disease.
8. How long does it take to get the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female report?
Reports are delivered within 24 hours of sample pickup. Samples collected in the early morning slot typically reach the Metropolis processing laboratory the same day, with digital reports emailed and sent on WhatsApp by the next evening. A few specialised parameters like Vitamin B12 or certain hormonal markers may need an additional 12 hours. You can also download the report anytime from your bookmytest.co.in dashboard or the Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number.

Yes. Metropolis Healthcare is among Indias most respected diagnostic chains, operating NABL-accredited and ISO-certified laboratories, with a senior panel of pathologists and decades of clinical reputation. The TruHealth series is designed in-house by Metropolis specialists and is widely used in corporate wellness, insurance health checks and individual preventive care across India. Booking the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female through bookmytest.co.in gives you the same lab quality with transparent partner pricing and zero hidden home-collection charges.

Yes, free home sample collection by trained Metropolis phlebotomists is available across 2,000+ pincodes covering all major metro cities, tier-2 cities and most tier-3 towns in India. After booking on bookmytest.co.in, a female phlebotomist (on request) arrives at your address in a 2-hour slot of your choosing, ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting samples. There are no extra charges for the visit, report generation or digital delivery — pricing remains transparent across the country.

The Expert Female package is the top tier in the Metropolis TruHealth series, built for Indian women aged 35 and above who want depth rather than just coverage. Beyond the standard heart, liver, kidney and thyroid panels, it adds advanced cancer-screening markers, an allergy panel, expanded hormonal indicators, inflammatory markers and detailed bone-health assessment in a single 90+ parameter sample. 2. Does the Metropolis Expert Female package include cancer screening?
Yes, the package includes advanced cancer-screening biomarkers relevant to Indian women, helping flag early biological changes long before symptoms appear. These markers are not a diagnosis on their own — they work as an early-warning layer alongside clinical examinations like mammography and Pap smear, both of which should still be done separately as per age guidelines. Women with a family history of breast, ovarian or cervical cancer benefit the most from this annual screening combination.
3. Which allergy parameters are tested in the Expert Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package includes an allergy screening panel that helps identify whether unexplained symptoms — chronic skin rash, recurrent sinus issues, persistent cough, food sensitivities, joint pain or gut discomfort — could be allergy-driven rather than infection-driven. This is increasingly relevant for Indian women aged 35+, where allergic and autoimmune presentations rise sharply. Specific allergen testing can then be ordered as a follow-up based on which broad category is flagged.
4. How does this package help women going through perimenopause and menopause?
Perimenopause typically begins between 38 and 45 in Indian women and brings symptoms like irregular periods, sleep disruption, mood changes, weight gain, hair fall, fatigue and palpitations — often confused with thyroid disorder or stress. The Expert Female package screens thyroid, key hormones, iron, Vitamin D, calcium and cardiac risk markers together, which is the exact combination needed to differentiate perimenopausal changes from other treatable conditions. Annual testing through this phase is strongly advised.

6. How often should the Expert Female checkup be repeated?
Annually for most women aged 35+, and every six months for women with a confirmed family history of cancer, autoimmune disease, diabetes or thyroid disorder, or those on long-term medication for hypertension, PCOS or hormonal therapy. The value of the Expert Female package compounds with repetition — a single report shows your current state, but two to three reports over consecutive years reveal trends in hormonal balance, bone density indicators, inflammation and metabolic markers that no one-time test can show.
7. What signs indicate I should upgrade from a basic checkup to the Expert Female?
Persistent fatigue despite normal basic reports, recurrent infections, unexplained weight changes, irregular cycles after age 35, family history of cancer or autoimmune disease, post-pregnancy symptoms that have not resolved, suspected hormonal imbalance, or any "everything is normal but I dont feel well" situation. Basic packages screen for common deficiencies; the Expert Female package screens for the deeper, often-missed causes — hormonal, allergic, autoimmune and inflammatory — that explain why symptoms persist when standard reports look fine.

The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package is a powerful blood-and-urine-based screening tool, but it does not replace clinical examinations like a Pap smear, pelvic exam, breast clinical examination, mammography, transvaginal ultrasound or bone-density DEXA scan.
